title: alerts.php response
description: Body returned by the alert webhook receiver. POST only (405 otherwise). Authenticated by either Langfuse's x-langfuse-signature header (t=<unix>,v1=<HMAC-SHA256 of '<t>.<body>' with LANGFUSE_WEBHOOK_SECRET>; rejected if tampered or older than 5 minutes) or an X-Alert-Token header / ?token= equal to ALERT_WEBHOOK_SECRET: 503 when neither secret is configured, 401 on a bad credential, 400 when the body is not a JSON object, 413 over 64 KiB. On 200 the alert has been written to the application log (WARNING 'copilot alert received') and the OpenEMR audit log (event clinical-copilot-alert). The inbound body is whatever the observability backend sends; the receiver lifts name/severity/type/id/value/threshold from the common locations and records the remaining keys by name only.

error.description: Present instead of received/alert/severity on a non-200.
